skill.summary: Converts written content into a podcast episode with AI narration and original intro/outro music. Use when repurposing blog posts into audio content.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—convert blog posts into podcast episodes with AI narration and custom intro/outro music.

- Transforms written content into audio with automated narration.
- Adds original intro and outro music to each episode.
- Designed for bloggers, solopreneurs, and content marketers to repurpose content easily.
- Supports SEO with targeted keywords for discoverability.
- Includes workflow and best-practice guidance for content accuracy and delivery.
